properties.scriptMethodHeader: def Script(spark: SparkSession, in0: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
properties.script:
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, collect_list, lit, concat_ws

df1 = in0.groupBy(col("PartNumber"), col("Facility"), col("Plant"))
df2 = df1.pivot("TransactionType")

return df2.agg(sum(col("Quantity")).alias("Sum"), lit(1).alias("_dummy_"))
